items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: Yeah, he used to play with Sidney Dusveen.

ctx.x: Oh, you're talking about Lewis Nelson, yeah. Well, we played together a long time. You say he played with Sidney Dusveen? Yeah, he used to play with Sidney Dusveen.
Let's get back to Robichaux. Back to Robichaux now.

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: Then after he got good, well, uh, Sidney Desiree got in.

ctx.x: What do you think? Who did he work with? We used to work with all these bands down there. All the big shot bands. He, he worked with me and Kid Hire as well. And we was the first one to hire them. Had them with the band. Then after he got good, well, uh, Sidney Desiree got in. And then, uh, after Sidney, they got on the boat to speak Marvin. And different bands he used to play with.
